pageAccessHeat.title: Access detail
pageAccessHeat.hintDesc: The console reports one page view per route change. Repeated visits to the same page by the same user are counted per occurrence; query strings and client IPs are not recorded.
pageAccessHeat.emptyHint: After this version is deployed, every page a user opens produces one record.
pageAccessHeat.noMatchHint: Try another keyword or time range.
